item.description:
## What’s new in 1.0.1
- A new first-run setup that makes Accessibility permission clear and easy - New Backpocket app and menu bar icons - Redesigned Settings and About, including built-in update controls - Import and export backups for your saved facts - Better handling for locked facts, iCloud sync, and the five-fact free plan - Privacy, terms, and bug reporting are now available inside the app
